calls.statement:
SELECT sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, round(sum(f.net_amount)/count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) atv_net,
 round(sum(f.gross_amount)/count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) atv_gross,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_id=1 THEN f.net_amount END)/count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.channel_id=1 THEN f.receipt_id END),2) atv_store,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_id>1 THEN f.net_amount END)/count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.channel_id>1 THEN f.receipt_id END),2) atv_web
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
